name: reserved-slots
author: Takaro
summary: Reserved slots for supporters and staff. Keep the last few slots free: when a supporter joins a full server, the newest (or lowest-playtime, or a random) regular player is kicked with a friendly message. Regular players who join into the reserved zone can be turned away. Staff can be exempt. Admin command shows current slot usage. Games without kick support fail gracefully.
description:
Reserved Slots keeps the last few player slots free for supporters (VIPs) and staff.

How it works, on every player join:
- Set Max players to your server's real player limit (Takaro does not report it). Public slots = Max players - Reserved slots.
- If more players are online than the public slots and the joining player has RESERVED_SLOT, one regular player is kicked to free a slot (strategy: newest join, lowest playtime, or random). Players with RESERVED_SLOT or RESERVED_SLOT_EXEMPT are never picked.
- If the joining player has no reserved slot and the server is in the reserved zone, they are kicked with a 'server full' message (can be turned off). Staff with RESERVED_SLOT_EXEMPT are always let in.
- The admin command `slots` shows online count, public and reserved slots, and who holds a reserved slot.

Messages support {link} (your VIP or donation link), {reserved} (reserved slot count) and {max} (max players).

Game support: the module needs kickPlayer from the game connector. On games where kick is not supported (for example Counter-Strike 2), the kick fails gracefully: the module logs it and keeps running; nobody is removed. With Max players set to 0 (the default) the module does nothing until you configure it.

maxPlayers.title: Max players
maxPlayers.description: Your server's player limit (Takaro cannot read it from the game). 0 = module is off until you set it.

reservedSlots.title: Reserved slots
reservedSlots.description: How many of the Max players slots are kept for players with the Reserved slot permission.

kickStrategy.title: Who gets kicked to free a slot
kickStrategy.description: newest = the regular player who joined last; lowestPlaytime = the regular player with the least total playtime on this server; random = any regular player.

kickNonReservedJoiners.title: Turn away regular players in the reserved zone
kickNonReservedJoiners.description: When on, a player without a reserved slot who joins while all public slots are taken is kicked with the 'server full' message.

vipLink.title: VIP link
vipLink.description: Where players can become a supporter. Replaces {link} in the messages.

freedSlotMessage.title: Kick reason: slot freed for a supporter
freedSlotMessage.default: Server full - slot freed for a supporter. Rejoin later or become VIP: {link}
freedSlotMessage.description: Kick reason for the regular player removed to make room. Supports {link}, {reserved}, {max}.

serverFullMessage.title: Kick reason: server full
serverFullMessage.default: Server full - the last {reserved} slots are reserved for supporters. Try again later or become VIP: {link}
serverFullMessage.description: Kick reason for a regular player who joins into the reserved zone. Supports {link}, {reserved}, {max}.

permissions.description: Player may use a reserved slot. When they join a full server, a regular player is kicked to make room. Never picked to be kicked.
For staff: never kicked by this module and always let in, but does not kick others when joining.
Allows using the slots command to see current slot usage.

slots.helpText: Shows online players, public and reserved slots, and who holds a reserved slot.

on-player-connected.description: Frees a slot for supporters, or turns away regular players in the reserved zone.
